_doc: EngDesign-Open is a 61-task evolution surface with no ID-based held-out set. EngDesign v1 hardens those same IDs and must be run as a separately labeled OOD surface, not as generic RRSI held-out IDs. Execution is disabled until a trusted task/evaluator runtime and isolated Engineering MCP runner are integrated.
_threadforge_modifications: Threadforge changes execution consent defaults and keeps EngDesign v1 as a separately named OOD surface because it shares the Open task IDs; see python/UPSTREAM_MODIFICATIONS.md.
